propositions: Production rich-text convergence mutates binding entries through shallow all_bindings() without lifecycle policy enforcement, requiring a named narrow mutation operation as a supported seam.
The new narrow operation must produce identical hash, counter, and persisted bytes as the legacy in-place mutation sequence for changed, unchanged, and missing binding cases.
The operation must perform no per-emit save on any path, delegating all persistence to the production caller's later unconditional pass-level save to avoid write amplification.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal, returning a distinct result from the operation while maintaining current behavior parity.
all_bindings() must retain shallow copy depth and all public facade signatures must remain unchanged to preserve compatibility.
